description: This file defines a base class for a Virtual File System (VFS) used in the Notesnook project, including method stubs for file operations and constants related to SQLite VFS.

classes.name: Base
classes.description: A base class for a Virtual File System (VFS) providing stub implementations for file operations.

methods.name: xClose
methods.description: Closes a file given its fileId, returns an error code.

methods.name: xRead
methods.description: Reads data from a file at a specified offset.

methods.name: xWrite
methods.description: Writes data to a file at a specified offset.

methods.name: xTruncate
methods.description: Truncates a file to a specified size.

methods.name: xFileSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of a file.

methods.name: xCheckReservedLock
methods.description: Checks for a reserved lock on a file.

methods.name: xFileControl
methods.description: Performs control operations on a file.

methods.name: xSectorSize
methods.description: Returns the sector size of the device.

methods.name: xOpen
methods.description: Opens a file with specified parameters.

methods.name: xAccess
methods.description: Checks access permissions for a file.

methods.name: handleAsync
methods.description: Handles asynchronous operations, meant to be overridden.
